ITEM 1 | Roasted or grilled chunks of a dark brown, charred-edged vegetable with pale cream interior, irregular cubes about 3-4 cm, glossy oily sheen, soft and holding shape, scattered across the left and upper part of the plate covering roughly 30% of the plate area | 150
ITEM 2 | Pale cream-colored pieces with golden-brown browned spots, possibly sliced and fanned, about 2 cm thick, moist-looking surface, one piece with dark charred edge, sitting in the center-right of the plate covering roughly 12% of the plate area | 90
ITEM 3 | Elongated pale tan strips with small darker flecks and granular speckles, about 8-10 cm long and 2-3 cm wide, matte slightly crumbly surface, lying along the lower-left of the plate covering roughly 10% of the plate area | 80
ITEM 4 | Dark brown glossy charred pieces with a sticky sheen, small chunks about 2-3 cm, clustered beneath and between the other items near the center, covering roughly 5% of the plate area | 30
ITEM 5 | Dark brown caramelized slices with crisp-looking edges and a glossy surface, about 4 cm long, sitting on the right side of the plate covering roughly 6% of the plate area | 35
